recommendation.text: The Board recommends the Administration ensure that the Office of the High Representative for the Least Developed Countries, Landlocked Developing Countries and Small Island Developing States, together with the Department of Economic and Social Affairs, conduct a comprehensive review of operational responsibilities to clarify roles, strengthen director-level communication, share work programmes and enhance collaboration with relevant entities, including the Development Coordination Office, with the aim of eliminating duplication, providing clear guidance to Member States on each entity’s role and fostering coherent, efficient support for small island developing States through structured inter-office cooperation.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends the Administration ensure that the Office of the High Representative for the Least Developed Countries, Landlocked Developing Countries and Small Island Developing States, together with the Department of Economic and Social Affairs, conduct a comprehensive review of operational responsibilities to clarify roles, strengthen director-level communication, share work programmes and enhance collaboration with relevant entities, including the Development Coordination Office, with the aim of eliminating duplication, providing clear guidance to Member States on each entity’s role and fostering coherent, efficient support for small island developing States through structured inter-office cooperation.
history.administration_response: The recommendation was implemented. The Office continues to coordinate with the Department of Economic and Social Affairs at the level of directors and other senior managers with a view to enhancing collaboration, eliminating duplication and fostering coherent support to small island developing States. Coordination has focused on shared responsibilities in respect of the interim secretariat of the multidimensional vulnerability index and in relation to coordination on the Small Island Developing States Partnership Framework.
history.board_assessment: Given that measures have been taken to actively coordinate with the Department of Economic and Social Affairs at the level of directors and other senior managers to enhance collaboration, eliminate duplication of work and foster coherent support for small island developing States, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
